title: af/ProjectPendingPublication@1
description: The machine-local entry the Surveyor's writer keeps in `pending/<hex of the Survey ID>.json` beside `project.lock` of its Project Store while it publishes one Survey (ADR-0152 clause 13): written under the Store's lock before the record's bytes enter the CAS, `object` added once they are written, removed once `SurveyRecorded@1` commits. Collection reads it: an entry whose event committed is cleared and nothing deleted; otherwise only the object at the Survey's CAS name with the entry's `length`, device and inode is reclaimed, as a planned `recovery`, and then the entry. Every number is decimal text; no path.

length.description: The length of the record's bytes: at most 1 MiB, the ceiling every Survey is written within.

object.description: The object as it was written, by device and inode; absent until it is.
